info.title: Element5 API
info.description:
Element5 APIs enables the clients to invoke and monitor Element5 Workflows. The E5 APIs are protected by API keys and the keys would be shared during the onboarding process. Due to the long running nature of workflows the current state of the workflows can be tracked either by polling E5 APIs for status or exposing a webhook which will be notified about progress. The below sections highlight the APIs and events which would be relevant for the current engagement.

# Authentication

<!-- ReDoc-Inject: <security-definitions> -->

tags.description: Generic E5 Task related APIs and Webhooks

get.description: Fetch a file object by its `object-id`. The file may be delivered directly as binary content or via a redirect to a pre-signed URL.

parameters.name: object-id
parameters.description: Provide a `object-id` to fetch the file object

200.description: File object delivered directly as binary content

302.description: File delivered via redirect to a pre-signed URL. The `Location` header contains the pre-signed URL where the file can be accessed.

Location.description: Pre-signed URL to access the file

401.description: API key is missing or invalid

403.description: Access forbidden. The API key is valid but does not have permission to access this file object.

put.description: Upload a file to S3 storage. The file is stored in a date-based folder structure (YYYY/MM/DD). Returns file object ID and download URL. Requires `file:write` scope in the authorization token.

Location.description: The URL to access the uploaded file object resource

400.description: Bad request - invalid file or missing data

403.description: Forbidden - insufficient permissions or client not found

413.description: Payload too large - file exceeds maximum size

post.description: All the necessary information required to submit an authorization. On receipt, the API performs a quick validation (not verification) of the request for correctness. On successful validation returns a `taskId` which can be used for tracking this request. Also, the `task#queued` event is triggered.

401.description: API key is missing or invalid

403.description: Access forbidden. The API key is valid but does not have permission to access this resource.

post.description: Due to the long running nature of workflows, Element5 has a webhook interface which sends out events at important junctures when a request is processed. The events would be posted to the Webhook URL which would be configured as part of the onboarding process. **Assumption:** The URLs and their access credentials would have been already shared to Element5 as part of the onboarding process.
